entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry for dragging you out here... I need[n]to get a pair of glasses.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've been wanting to come here for a[n]while, but I never had the chance to[n]drop by.
You have bad eyesight?
You're looking to buy?[clr 27]
I have enough glasses.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Me? Well, a little. I usually wear my[n]contacts, though.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But I'm not looking for a pair for me.[n]I was hoping to find a good gift[n]for my dad.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yeah! I want to get my dad a present.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, good thing I'm not buying for[n]you, [lName]-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's a present for my dad.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You seem like a real glasses buff, so[n]I wanted to get your advice.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Could you try on a couple pairs for me?[n]I'd like to get some visual reference.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you so much! Let's see...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: How about this pair?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Wow, those really work for you! You[n]look so cool!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What do you think?
A pretty modern look.[clr 27]
Not my style.
I look so aloof in these.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I know, it's so fashionable! And it's good[n]that it'd help your vision, too.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, you don't think so? I thought they[n]fit you pretty well...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I think that's just your aura. Usually the[n]glasses kind of hide it, but you still get[n]flashes of it here and there...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This could be a good one... Hmm...
Do they suit your dad, though?
I'm not so sure...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Hmm, right—maybe a little too hip[n]for my dad.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But your input's been really helpful[n]so far! Would you mind poking[n]around with me for a bit longer?
Of course.[clr 27]
Let's keep going.[clr 27]
Sure, whatever.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you! This is actually kind of fun!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Let's pick up the pace!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, someone's enthusiastic! You're[n]enjoying this too, huh?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Then let's keep going! Time for some[n]high-speed glasses modeling!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I really appreciate it. Let's find our[n]next pair, then.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Wow, you look like a salesman! But it[n]doesn't feel right, somehow...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Those definitely leave an impression![n]Heck, people might remember the[n]glasses and nothing else about you!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You're like a star right out of Hollywood![n]But if my dad wore them, he might look[n]a little... shady.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Why are those even here!? I... kind of[n]want a pair.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry... I can't decide.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: A lot of them are good, but none of them[n]have really clinched it for me yet...
Trust your instincts.
Don't overthink it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You know, you're right! I'm the one who[n]has to make this call!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...I'm just going off a gut feeling, but...[n]I'll pick this pair.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I don't know how to describe it. It just[n]seems perfect for my dad somehow.
Good choice.[clr 27]
I'm sure he'll love it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes, I think I can be confident in this[n]one. In fact, I know he'll like it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Definitely! That's what my gut tells me!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you so much for coming here[n]with me today!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I ended up with a great present. All[n]thanks to you, [lName]-senpai!
It's part of our deal.
Not a problem at all.
I expect compensation.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Then I'll have to make it worth your[n]time, Senpai. Let's go practice at[n]Inokashira Park after this!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: *giggle* Well, I've still got to make[n]it up to you. Let's go practice at[n]Inokashira Park after this!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Of course! As part of our deal, right?[n]We should go train at Inokashira Park[n]after this!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...If I'm being honest, trying to pick out[n]glasses was really setting off my[n]anxiety.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: All I could think of was what'd happen[n]if I couldn't choose, or if I chose wrong...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I mean, I already failed in gymnastics.[n]And my cooking turned out bad, too.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: After cracking under pressure so many[n]times, I kind of figured I'd just ruin[n]everything again.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: The more I thought about it, the more...[n]empty I felt. Like I wasn't even me[n]anymore.
Everyone deals with that.[clr 27]
That's your slump talking.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: So even you know how that feels,[n][lName]-senpai? It's not just me...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, yes... but...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I think I'm starting to understand what[n]my coach was telling me.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's easy to say you're in a slump, and[n]write yourself off.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But maybe "finding out who I really am"[n]is also about finding new depths to[n]myself.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It does make me feel a little down, but[n]at the same time, I feel like I'm closer[n]to getting my confidence back.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: And having your support makes me[n]even more determined to make that[n]happen.
Good luck.
We'll work at it together.[clr 27]
No rush, though.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you so much! I even feel confident[n]just hearing you say that!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This is strange... I don't know if I[n]should be feeling like this.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I want to give my best performance, but[n]it's like I'd be doing it for you as much as[n]for myself... o-or something like that!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You're right. The coach did tell me[n]it's best to take things steady.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm still working on myself, but I hope[n]we can keep helping each other, too!
I can sense a strong[n]trust from Kasumi...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Now, we should get to training! Maybe[n]we can try some intermediate-level[n]exercises today.
After stretching, I trained[n]with Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Let's stop there. Good effort today!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I should get going. I'll contact you[n]again soon!
